cyberware.name: Reflex Booster
cyberware.effect: Once per round, gain +1 bonus die to an Evade check.

cyberware.name: Targeting Link
cyberware.effect: Once per round, ignore 1 level of cover when attacking an enemy you can see.

cyberware.name: Low-Light Optics
cyberware.effect: Ignore penalty dice caused by darkness within medium range.

cyberware.name: EMP Shielding
cyberware.effect:
Activate as a reaction before being affected by incoming EMP. The EMP has no effect on installed cyberware.

Once activated, EMP Shielding cannot be reactivated for 10 minutes.

cyberware.name: Metabolic Filter
cyberware.effect: Gain +1 bonus die on checks to resist toxins or narcotics.

cyberware.name: Internal Communicator
cyberware.effect: Gain the ability to send and receive messages mentally just as if you were using a regular comms device.

cyberware.name: Skull Popper
cyberware.effect: Highly illegal; when installed, is given a mandate such as “don’t go to the police”. If the host violates this mandate, the Skull Popper explodes, killing the host. The more specific the mandate, the better the implant functions. A Skull Popper boots automatically when installation is completed and cannot be voluntarily shut down. If it is forced to shut down or reduced to 0 durability, roll 1d12. On a result of 1-9, it detonates.

cyberware.name: Databank
cyberware.effect: You gain an internal information storage device. You may store information upon it (thinking you want to record what you see, for example), and access information from it at will. You may also load external information onto it, though the GM determines how long that takes and how much may be stored on it.

cyberware.name: Invisible Databank
cyberware.effect: You gain an internal information storage device. You may store information upon it (thinking you want to record what you see, for example), and access information from it at will. This device cannot be seen or accessed externally without removing it and is shielded to avoid electronic detection.

cyberware.name: Neural Accelerator
cyberware.effect: Once per day, activate to gain 3 additional actions on your turn. At the end of your turn, gain +2 stress.

cyberware.name: Threat Awareness Suite
cyberware.effect: Gain +1 bonus die to Observe or Instinct checks to detect ambushes or imminent danger. Additionally, you may not be Surprised.

cyberware.name: Synthetic Musculature
cyberware.effect: Gain +1 bonus die on Powerlift or Athletics checks involving lifting, pushing, or breaking objects. Unarmed attacks gain +1 damage.

cyberware.name: Stability Gyros
cyberware.effect: Ignore penalty dice from unstable environments (moving vehicles, zero-G, poor footing)

cyberware.name: Adrenal Boost
cyberware.effect: Activate to ignore stress penalties for 1 round. At the end of this round, take 1 damage.

cyberware.name: Mantis Claws (retractable)
cyberware.effect:
Activating the claws extends them from your arms. They then remain extended until they are activated again, which retracts them.

While extended, gain: PHYS unarmed attacks deal damage equal to your PHYS + 2 and have Shredding (2). REF unarmed attacks deal damage equal to half your REF (rounded up) + 1, and have Piercing (2). Additionally, gain +1 bonus die to climbing related checks.

While shut down, the claws cannot be extended or retracted. If already extended, attacks with them use your normal unarmed damage. They do not gain any special traits. The climbing bonus remains while the claws are extended.

Attacks made with Mantis Claws always deal Blade type damage.

cyberware.name: Neuro Regulator
cyberware.effect: Ignore up to 3 stress per day from up to 3 sources of stress. Make all SOC based rolls with +1 penalty die.

cyberware.name: Synthetic Antibodies
cyberware.effect: Become immune to nanites targeting your body (including positive effects). Does not stop things from being thrown at you with nanites.

cyberware.name: Bio-Stabilizer
cyberware.effect:
When you would take a Moderate or Heavy wound, roll Cybernetics (DC8).
This effect may only trigger once per instance of damage.
